website.readmeExcerpt:
# The Crystarium Boutique

**Browse FFXIV's wardrobe like a boutique.**

Current release: **v0.1.5**

The Crystarium Boutique (TCB) was created because building a glamour should feel like browsing a wardrobe—not searching item-name databases, juggling external sites, and repeatedly opening separate preview windows.

> **See something interesting → click it → see it on your character.**

Browse equipment visually, experiment with pieces and dyes, save ideas, organize discoveries, and learn where supported items come from without leaving the Boutique.

**Quick links:** [Features](#features) · [Installation](#installation) · [Discord Community & Video Guide](#video-guides--discord-community) · [Support](#support) · [License](#license-and-credits)

> ### Want to see TCB in action?
>
> Join the [TCB Discord community](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX) and visit its **Guide** section for video demonstrations and screenshots of the features explained below.

## Features

### Visual Boutique

Browse FFXIV equipment as an icon-first wardrobe instead of an item-name list. Choose an equipment slot, move freely through visual pages, and discover pieces you may not have known existed. Newer equipment appears first, filters narrow the catalog, and unusable equipment is visually distinguished where supported.

TCB deliberately keeps meaningful visual variants separate, including where applicable:

- Baked color and material differences
- Different dye-slot support
- Relic stages
- Glowing and standard replicas
- Matte replicas
- Other versions with meaningfully different appearances

Items sharing a model remain separate obtainable items. TCB does not collapse them merely because they look alike.

### Real-time preview

Left Click an item to preview it immediately on your character. Rapidly swap pieces, mix different sets, and keep the active Boutique appearance while experimenting—without repeatedly using FFXIV's separate preview windows.

For Head items:

- **Left Click** applies the headpiece with its optional visor piece hidden.
- **Ctrl + Left Click** applies its full or alternate visor appearance when supported.
- Headgear without a supported visual difference remains safe and simply looks the same.

### Revert to Last Item

The bottom-right Revert control restores the immediately previous Boutique selection for that equipment slot. It is available in both Boutique and Favorites, and both views share the same previous-item history. A normal successful Revert changes only that selection rather than resetting the full character.

### Crystal Wardrobe and real-time dyes

Crystal Wardrobe is TCB's working canvas. It shows the active previewed equipment and both supported dye channels, lets you remove individual pieces where supported, and can automatically synchronize after FFXIV applies a genuine gearset change.

- **Dye Slot 1** and **Dye Slot 2** open the Dye Studio for immediate dye preview.
- Compatible replacement equipment retains relevant active dyes.
- Individual dye channels can be removed independently.
- **Clear All Dye Slots** removes active dyes while keeping the current equipment intact.
- **Reset Character** returns the Wardrobe and character to the current game state.
- Vertical and Horizontal layouts are available, and the Wardrobe window adapts its dimensions when orientation changes.

Right Click an equipped Wardrobe card removes that piece from the current Boutique appearance where supported. Right Click in the main Boutique remains Favorites management.

**Clear All Dye Slots affects only active dyes in the current Boutique session.** It does not edit dyes stored in saved Designs. Loading a saved Design can intentionally restore that Design's saved dyes.

### Search and filters

Combine filters to focus the visual catalog:

- Equipment Slot
- Expansion
- Role, including Limited Role where applicable
- Dye Slots
- Required Character Level
- Item Name / Search

The **Level** control is manual numeric entry and uses the item's required/equip character level—not Item Level. Entering `60`, for example, shows equipment requiring levels 1–60.

The Designs control is also available directly from the Boutique so saved appearances can be used while browsing.

### Favorites and custom lists

Right Click a Boutique item to save it as a Favorite. All Favorites provides one combined collection, while custom named lists can organize pieces by job, character, theme, or glamour concept. The same item may belong to multiple lists.

Favorites support search, equipment-type filtering, direct preview, newest-first ordering, and Revert to Last Item. From a named list, an item can be removed from only that list without losing its other memberships, or removed from Favorites completely.

The upper-right Favorite emblem identifies saved items throughout normal Boutique browsing. An optional configurable Favorite frame is available and defaults to off.

Favorites can be as simple as:

> “I don't know what I'm doing with this yet, but I definitely want to remember it.”

Or as intentional as:

> “I have a concept—let's make a list of things that might work.”

### Designs

A Design stores equipment, dyes, weapon pieces, a custom name, and optional notes. Save completed glamours or unfinished ideas, then manage them from the Designs tab.

Available operations include:

- Preview/load and inspect equipment and dyes
- Rename
- Duplicate
- Overwrite/update
- Delete
- Review acquisition information
- Generate a movable item-reference/checklist window

If a Design contains equipment that cannot validly apply to the current job, TCB retains valid active equipment for that slot instead of presenting incompatible gear as successfully active.

**Export Design** creates a portable TCB Design string. **Import Design** saves another player's compatible TCB Design string for later loading.

TCB can also import supported public Eorzea Collection glamour URLs. The imported appearance can be previewed, changed, dyed, and saved as a normal TCB Design. See [Design Import](docs/DESIGN-IMPORT.md) for supported formats and limitations.

### Item information and where to get it

Hover an item to see its identity, level, dye support, and locally indexed acquisition details. Where sufficiently reliable data exists, TCB can describe:

- **Vendors:** vendor name, location, currency, and exchange cost
- **Crafting:** crafting job, recipe requirements, and required materials
- **Quests and achievements:** quest sources/rewards and achievement rewards
- **Other sources:** Market Board, Mog Station/FFXIV Online Store, Treasure Hunt, and other obtainable-from information
- **Duties:** Dungeons, Trials, Raids, Savage content where represented, Alliance Raids, duty names, duty drops, boss chests, duty chests/coffers, and raid series/tier information
- **Shared appearances:** other separately obtainable items using the same appearance/model family

Exact bosses are named only when reliable item-to-source evidence establishes that relationship. Missing acquisition information does **not** mean an item is invalid, unobtainable, or unavailable; it means TCB does not currently have sufficiently reliable information for that source.

Core catalog and packaged acquisition lookup are local and offline during normal browsing. See [Data Sources](docs/DATA-SOURCES.md) for provenance and limitations.

### Known-owned item indicators

When TCB can positively confirm that the current character owns an exact item, its card displays a green checkmark in the upper-left. Supported sources are:

- Inventory
- Equipped gear
- Armoury Chest
- Armoire
- Glamour Dresser

A green check means TCB knows that exact item is owned. No check means TCB does not currently have confirmed ownership information—it does not prove the item is unowned.

Ownership is exact-item only. A visually identical shared-model, replica, relic-related, or alternate-color item does not receive a check unless **that exact item** is known owned. The Favorite emblem remains in the upper-right, so Favorite and ownership status can appear together.

To track Glamour Dresser ownership, open the Glamour Dresser at least once on **each character**. After a complete successful dresser load, TCB stores a per-character snapshot. Its checks survive zoning, plugin reload, and game restart; opening the dresser again refreshes the saved snapshot.

TCB does not currently claim ownership from Saddlebags or Retainers.

### Themes and customization

TCB includes three themes:

1. **The Crystarium Boutique** — stained-glass presentation with decorative metal and gold framing.
2. **Simple Crystarium Boutique** — Crystarium-inspired colors and typography with a cleaner, restrained background.
3. **Simple** — the compact neutral Dalamud-style presentation.

Fresh configurations default to **The Crystarium Boutique**. Existing users retain their saved theme choice when updating.

Appearance settings include font and button colors, background transparency, Favorite highlighting, interface scaling, layouts, tooltip presentation, and other theme-specific options.

## Video Guides & Discord Community

This README explains the complete player-facing feature set, but many features are easier to understand by watching them.

Join the [TCB Discord community](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX) and visit the **Guide** section for screenshots and videos demonstrating:

- Visual Boutique browsing and real-time preview
- Visor controls and Revert to Last Item
- Crystal Wardrobe and Dye Studio
- Search, filters, Favorites, and Favorite lists
- Designs, Design dropdown usage, import, and sharing
- Acquisition tooltips and shared appearances
- Themes and customization
- Known-Owned indicators and Glamour Dresser tracking

The Discord also provides announcements, update information, installation help, feature explanations, bug reports, feedback, feature requests, glamour discussion, Design sharing, community glamour showcases, and general TCB discussion.

**Permanent invite:** https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX

## Installation

Add the public TCB repository to Dalamud's **Experimental / Custom Plugin Repositories**:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aesthria/The-Crystarium-Boutique/main/repo.json
```

1. Open Dalamud Settings and add the URL under Experimental/Custom Plugin Repositories.
2. Save and refresh the repository list.
3. Open `/xlplugins`.
4. Search for **The Crystarium Boutique** and install it.
5. Future releases will appear through Dalamud's normal plugin-update flow.

See [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md) for expanded setup and update guidance.

## Requirements

- Windows
- FINAL FANTASY XIV through XIVLauncher with a current Dalamud installation
- Glamourer installed separately for appearance preview and restoration
- Penumbra installed separately only if its optional emergency redraw fallback is desired

Without Glamourer, TCB remains usable in browse-only mode. Penumbra is an optional emergency redraw fallback if Glamourer unloads during an active preview. Neither dependency nor either API assembly is bundled with TCB.

## Commands

- `/boutique`
- `/tcb`
- `/cb`

All three commands toggle the same Boutique experience.

## Privacy and local-first behavior

TCB uses local game data for its equipment catalog and packaged local data for acquisition lookup. Favorites, Favorite lists, settings, Designs, and per-character Glamour Dresser ownership snapshots are stored locally.

Normal browsing does not contact a live price or acquisition service. The explicit Eorzea Collection URL import is the exception: TCB accesses the requested external resource only after the player submits a supported public URL.

## Support

Start with [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md), then consult [Support](SUPPORT.md) for reporting guidance. Security-sensitive concerns belong under the [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

For feature demonstrations, installation discussion, feedback, Design sharing, and community help, join the [TCB Discord](https://discord.gg/qfcKTPr3gX).

## Dependencies and data sources

TCB is built with the Dalamud plugin SDK and uses Lumina-backed game data exposed by Dalamud. It interoperates with independently installed Glamourer and Penumbra through narrow Dalamud IPC contracts.

TCB does not bundle `Glamourer.Api.dll`, `Glamourer.dll`, `Penumbra.Api.dll`, `Penumbra.dll`, or `Luna.dll`.

The acquisition supplement is packaged for offline use from pinned, reviewed sources and validated stable IDs. See [Dependencies](DEPENDENCIES.md), [Data Sources](docs/DATA-SOURCES.md), and [Third-Party Notices](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Building from source

The validated build targets .NET 10, Windows x64, and Dalamud API 15. Install the SDK selected by `global.json` and provide a compatible Dalamud development environment.

```powershell
dotnet restore CrystariumBoutique.sln --locked-mode
.\scripts\Build.ps1 -Configuration Release -SkipStage
```

Maintainer packaging and release procedures are documented in [Release Infrastructure](docs/RELEASE.md).

## License and credits

See [LICENSE](LICENSE), [COPYRIGHT.md](COPYRIGHT.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [Third-Party Notices](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md), and [Asset Provenance](docs/ASSET-PROVENANCE.md).

TCB uses or interoperates with work from the Dalamud/XIVLauncher ecosystem, Lumina, Glamourer, Penumbra, Critical-Impact/LuminaSupplemental, Newtonsoft.Json, .NET, xUnit.net, and other listed development dependencies. Each remains independently maintained and governed by its own license.
